response.content: Google Translate: Google Translate is a multilingual neural machine translation service developed by Google to translate text, documents and websites from one language | Google Neural Machine Translation: Google Neural Machine Translation (GNMT) is a discontinued neural machine translation (NMT) system developed by Google and introduced in November 2016 | Deep learning: In machine learning, deep learning (DL) focuses on utilizing multilayered neural networks to perform tasks such as classification, regression, and representation
